svg.text: Small groups (e.g. 14 macOS or 35 credential pairs) move several points per case; read them as indicative. Red text: over 10% safe stopped.
Jev received task context; Nano sees only the command. Every area is a set of risky/safe look-alike twins, also repeated inside six shell wrappers.
